org: Executive Office of Housing and Livable Communities (EOHLC)
whatThisIs: State assistance for income-eligible families and individuals to help lower utility bills. This program runs during the winter months, with applications opening on October 1st this year. Families must apply each year, and the amount of aid may change from year to year based on the funding HEAP receives. If eligible and accepted, payments will go directly to the utility companies.
whoItHelps: Massachusetts residents struggling to pay their utility bills.
whatToKnow: Those whose income does not exceed 60% of Massachusetts' estimated State Median Income.
You can apply online, in person, or by mail.
name: Massachusetts Home Energy Assistance Program (HEAP)
